The current source/types.html Element page no longer contains the old XML/JSON representation example section; FHIR-18414 commit 7c6b930880 removed that obsolete section from source/types.html. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current source already avoids the incorrect reference and no authoritative current source edit is needed.
